title: ReviewsSignalImportRequest
description: reviews.signal-import-request@1: bodies of reviews.signal.import on OpenVibe.Reviews (Reviews editors and granted services; 403 reviews.editor_required). POST /api/v1/signals/import { source_item_id } (or { item_id }) fetches one OpenVibe.Sources item (sources.item.read) and applies it: 422 signal.invalid_source_item, 404 signal.source_item_not_found, 422 signal.invalid_item / signal.no_provenance, 503 sources.unavailable. POST /api/v1/sources/sync takes no body and pulls the next pages of category-reviews items in change order, then drains the import queue.
